decisions.reason: Both questions ask only what the treaty symbolizes; the evidence line says it symbolizes cooperation and peace, so a correct answer such as peace or cooperation would not match the label peace from trivial beginnings. The questions no longer ask for exactly that label.
decisions.suggested_fix: Ask for the origin-framing explicitly without synonyms of trivial, e.g. what kind of beginnings the peace symbolized by the Scribble Treaty is said to have come from.
